title: The Telangana (Regulation of Appointments to Public Services and Rationalisation of Staff Pattern and Pay Structure) Act, 1994.
full_text: The Telangana (Regulation of Appointments to Public Services and Rationalisation of Staff Pattern and Pay Structure) Act, 1994. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19942 Act Number: 2 Enactment Date: 1994-01-15 Act Year: 1994 Short Title: The Telangana (Regulation of Appointments to Public Services and Rationalisation of Staff Pattern and Pay Structure) Act, 1994. Long Title: An Act to Regulate Appointments and Prohibit Irregular Appointments in offices and establishments under the control of the State Government, Local Authorities, Corporations owned and controlled by the State Government and other bodies established under a law made by the Legislature of the State to rationalise the staff pattern and pay structure of employees therein and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto. Department: Department of Finance Enforcement Date: 25-11-1993 Type: STATE Location: Telangana Schedule 1. The Schedule.
